source='''from collections import deque\n\ndef transform(grid):\n    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])\n    bg = min(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))\n    # The large background color is assumed to be the canvas.\n    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))\n    outside = set()\n    q = deque()\n    for r in range(h):\n        for c in (0, w - 1):\n            if grid[r][c] == bg and (r, c) not in outside:\n                outside.add((r, c)); q.append((r, c))\n    for c in range(w):\n        for r in (0, h - 1):\n            if grid[r][c] == bg and (r, c) not in outside:\n                outside.add((r, c)); q.append((r, c))\n    while q:\n        r, c = q.popleft()\n        for nr, nc in ((r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)):\n            if 0 <= nr < h and 0 <= nc < w and grid[nr][nc] == bg and (nr,nc) not in outside:\n                outside.add((nr,nc)); q.append((nr,nc))\n    out = [row[:] for row in grid]\n    for r in range(h):\n        for c in range(w):\n            if grid[r][c] == bg and (r,c) not in outside:\n                out[r][c] = 4\n    return out\n'''
